Title: Sweet & sour chicken
SubHeader: Crispy chicken with vegetables, wok sauce and rice

Ingredients.Name: chives
Ingredients.PreparationNote: half finely chopped, half in rings

Instructions:
Preparation

Prepare rice according to directions on packet.

Season flour with pepper and salt. Coat chicken breast pieces in flour.

Then combine with yogurt. Make sure each piece is fully coated in yogurt.

Cover coated chicken pieces one by one in the panko breadcrumbs, so that they are fully covered.

Preheat aerofryer to 190°C.

Place chicken pieces out over aerofryer basket. Cook 10 minutes until crisp and done. Give a good shake halfway through.

Meanwhile, heat two tbsp oil in a wok. Stir-fry vegetables, except for chive rings, for 5 minutes until softened. Add sweet & sour sauce and cook a little longer. As last, add crispy chicken pieces and combine.

Serve the Sweet and Sour Chicken with rice. Sprinkle with chive rings.
Note: You need: Pepper, salt and sunflower oil.
